entities.summary: Eduard Karl Joseph Michael Marcus Antonius Koloman Volkhold Maria Habsburg-Lothringen is a Hungarian diplomat who served as Hungary's ambassador to the Holy See from 2015 to 2025. He is a member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, the former ruling family of Austria-Hungary.
